description: Independent Polish evaluation corpus for Kiero (issue E1). 50 synthetic cases with human-authored answer keys. No real company data; every asset is synthetic with recorded provenance.

assetPolicy.images: Deterministic SVG, generated by evals/corpus/assets/generate-images.mjs (seeded, reproducible). sha256 recorded per asset in case fixtures.
assetPolicy.voice: Synthetic audio PENDING GENERATION (owned by D6/J3 tooling). Each voice part carries assetProvenance.status=pending_generation and a statement that the fixture transcript is the source of truth for expected STT.
assetPolicy.text: Inline in case fixtures; no external asset.
assetPolicy.realData: Forbidden. All names, amounts, places and events are invented for this corpus.

versioningRule: Any edit to any case or expected file bumps corpusRevision (format YYYY.MM.N) for the whole corpus. Prior results are interpreted against the revision recorded in their run reports.
